description: Make a set of stickers from one prompt or photo, cut apart locally. Optional transparent backgrounds. No server required.

defaultPrompt: Make a meme pack of a grumpy robot having a very bad morning
Make a set of a tiny wizard frog in 9 totally different styles

interface.longDescription: Describe any idea or send any photo and GifGen makes a whole sticker set out of it in one go: nine takes on the same character, each a different reaction, cut apart into separate images you can download — on transparent backgrounds when you ask for it
